goal: 共同闭合 ACP stdio/MCP 提供端与 subagent 消费者的完整请求生命周期
acceptance: Specify one source-backed provider/consumer contract before ready: identity, capabilities/version negotiation, ordered notifications, request cancellation, persisted sessions, MCP ownership and teardown.
Drive real stdio JSON-RPC initialize/new/prompt/cancel/list/resume/close/config with two Sessions, durable restoration and malformed/closed/late-result failures; no Agent=None success fallback.
MCP stdio/network transport and permission requests preserve exact Session/Agent ownership; disposable effects drain output and descendants on disconnect/unload.
Necessary ACP subagent consumers, canonical profile/launcher and extracted Portable execute the same bounded journeys; source-only ACP 139 tests do not certify Python parity.
open_findings: Python bridge still has no complete stdio app registration, reports protocolVersion as a string, and lacks ordered update drain/request signal, persistent session controls, MCP/permissions and complete subagent closure.
next_action: 基于固定原版 index/session/updates/model-control/mcp 与 11 个源测试文件先定义共享合同，再实现提供端和必要 subagent 消费者。additionalDirectories 拒绝与 authenticate 空行为原版已有，不列为迁移缺陷；不将已集成 prompt 归属范围写成完整 ACP 完成。
